Alex Kim: Hey folks — quick question. I uploaded a marriage certificate in Rippling but my spouse still shows as 'dependent pending' for dental. I did it yesterday. Is there a separate upload location for benefits?

Maya (People Ops): Hi @Alex Kim — welcome! If you uploaded to My Documents it's probably fine, but for benefits please upload under the Benefits-specific doc category so our team picks it up faster. We need either a marriage certificate or joint tax return + spouse SSN/DOB.

Alex Kim: Ah ok. I uploaded to 'Personal Docs' by mistake. Can you point me exactly where to re-upload?

Luca (HR Systems): @Alex Kim go to Rippling -> Documents -> Add Document. For Category choose "Benefits" and Subtype "Dependent proof". Filename doesn't matter but we recommend: `alex_kim_spouse_marriage_certificate.pdf`.

Luca (HR Systems): Example:```Rippling > Documents > Add Document > Category: Benefits > Dependent proof```Upload there and tick "Share with Benefits Team" if prompted.

Benefits Bot: Document received and queued for verification. Ticket #BZ-6123. Status: pending review. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Maya (People Ops): Once you re-upload we'll normally verify within 1-2 business days. After verification the dependent status flips and payroll deductions for the dental plan will start on the next pay cycle. If you're within 30 days of your hire date it's retroactive to your enrollment date; after 30 days it may be a qualifying life event — DM me if you're past 30 days.

Jordan (Payroll): FYI @Alex Kim — deductions show up as a payroll line item labeled "Dental - Employee + Dependent" on the next paycheck after verification. If you want to confirm timing, send your pay period end date and we can confirm which paycheck will reflect it.

Alex Kim: Thanks — re-uploaded under Benefits and shared with Benefits Team. Ticket said BZ-6123. Also, do I need to update anything for flex spending (FSA) to cover dependent dental?

Maya (People Ops): If you have FSA and want dependent dental covered you'll need to update your FSA elections in Rippling > Benefits > Manage Elections. If it's outside open enrollment we can only change with a qualifying life event (adding spouse qualifies). I'll mark your ticket to allow an FSA midyear change and follow up.

Alex Kim: Great — appreciate it. I'll keep an eye on the ticket. :slightly_smiling_face:

Maya (People Ops): No problem — ping @Maya if anything looks stuck after 48 hours or email benefits@redwood.com with the ticket number. :thumbsup:

Alex Kim: Will do, thanks everyone!
